newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 7.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
Sailing was closed to smaller boats at Tampico, Altamira and El Mezquital amid winds of 30 to 40 kilometers per hour.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Clouds and light rain travelling with a cold front from south Chihuahua state along the coasts of the Baja California peninsula and Sonora state.
Dominant winds from the northwest at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high. In Michoacan and Chiapas states winds at same intensity from the southwest.

A stationary cold front from the Florida peninsula in the north of Veracruz state. Winds from the northeast at 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and gusts up to 47 km/28 miles per hour along coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz states.
Humidity and light clouds in Central America and winds from the southeast up to 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
